BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to the taxation of beekeepers; adding new sectionsto chapter 82.04 RCW; adding a new section to chapter 82.08 RCW; addinga new section to chapter 82.12 RCW; and providing an effective date.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 82.04 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: This chapter does not apply to amounts derived from the wholesalesale of bee products by a person who owns or keeps forty-five or morebee colonies used for pollination and is registered under RCW15.60.021. For the purposes of this section, "bee products" meansqueen bees, packaged bees, honey, pollen, bee's wax, propolis, or othersubstances obtained from honey bees. Bee products do not includemanufactured substances or articles.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 82.04 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: This chapter does not apply to amounts received by any apiaristregistered under RCW 15.60.021 from providing bee pollination services p. 1 SB 6299using a bee colony owned or kept by the person providing thepollination services, if the person owns or keeps forty-five or morebee colonies.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 82.08 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The tax levied by RCW 82.08.020 does not apply to the sale ofpollinating bees to an apiarist registered under RCW 15.60.021 if theapiarist owns or keeps forty-five or more bee colonies used forpollination.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 82.12 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The provisions of this chapter do not apply in respect to the useof pollinating bees by an apiarist registered under RCW 15.60.021 ifthe apiarist owns or keeps forty-five or more bee colonies used forpollination.
